name: TalentXcel Global Distribution Engine Graph
operating_principle: Distribution through Product Utility, AI Discovery, UGC Living Entities, and Viral Sharing Loops — not thin SEO articles.

six_acquisition_engines.name: Search Engine Acquisition
six_acquisition_engines.mechanism: Intent-matched canonical pages -> fast server-rendered HTML -> schema rich snippets -> organic clicks

six_acquisition_engines.name: Generative AI Discovery & GEO
six_acquisition_engines.mechanism: Factual entity extraction -> structured comparison tables -> authoritative citation schema -> AI answer inclusion

six_acquisition_engines.name: Product-Led Utility & Tool Entrance
six_acquisition_engines.mechanism: Zero-login first value moment -> calculated output -> optional unlock / save to account -> high activation

six_acquisition_engines.name: User-Generated Growth Entities
six_acquisition_engines.mechanism: Every user creates a living, indexable, sharable public credential object -> organic backlink generation

six_acquisition_engines.name: Viral & Peer Distribution Loops
six_acquisition_engines.mechanism: Shareable scorecards + credential verification badges + candidate referrals -> K-factor compounding

six_acquisition_engines.name: External Distribution & Partnerships
six_acquisition_engines.mechanism: Direct institutional placement data feeds + campus ambassador onboarding + bulk employer ingestion

compounding_loop_spec.step_1_entry: Search / AI / Social / Referral Visitor arrives on specific utility
compounding_loop_spec.step_2_value: Zero-friction first value moment (ATS score, salary calculation, job apply)
compounding_loop_spec.step_3_signup: One-click consented registration to save / apply / export
compounding_loop_spec.step_4_action: User completes core product activation action
compounding_loop_spec.step_5_distribution: User shares Career Passport / ATS Score / invites peer to network
compounding_loop_spec.step_6_regeneration: Shared object becomes a new public indexable / discoverable entity
